rocksndiamonds.title: Rocks'n'Diamonds

source.imported: Upstream tree imported into this repository at 83f44f2 (file for file the same as the upstream commit, which was also upstream's head on 3 November 2026); build-amiga.sh builds it as imported, with patches/ applied to a copy

rocksndiamonds.contentPolicy: Engine GPL-2.0 (Artsoft Entertainment, Holger Schemel; COPYING). The game data in the tree carries no licence of its own (README, Data and licences): the classic level sets recreate commercial games' levels and the three music modules are third-party demoscene tracks, so neither is ever packed; upstream's own graphics, sounds, rhythm loop, tutorials and documents are packed for lab runs only until Dale decides on them.
